## Status and use

This is the design data dictionary for the first registry release. **Core** fields are required for safe workflow, denominator management and M01--M26 reporting. **Extended** fields may be added later or hidden in the initial REDCap build. **Derived** fields are calculated in REDCap or the analysis pipeline and should not be manually entered.

Dates are collected as `date_dmy`. Repeating instruments use the REDCap repeat instance as their operational row identifier; a separate typed event ID is optional and not required for analysis.

## Shared reporting metric codebook

| Codes | Purpose |
|---|---|
| M01--M06 | Diabetes burden and descriptive measures |
| M07--M19 | Care processes, clinical control, prevention and treatment measures |
| M20 | Diagnosis-confirmation quality |
| M21--M26 | Review coverage and delivery of the structured care pathway |

## Table 1. Baseline — single current record per person

| Variable | Meaning / values | Status | Metrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `internal_redcap_id` | System-generated registry record key | Core | All |
| `sh_diabetes_id` | Controlled local registry ID, with check digit when adopted | Core | All/linkage |
| `emis_id` | Legacy EMIS patient identifier, if available | Core | Linkage |
| `psource_id` | PatientSource patient identifier, if available | Core | Linkage |
| `date_of_entry` | Date first entered in the registry | Core | M01, M13 |
| `date_of_birth` | Date of birth | Core | M03, M05, M17 |
| `sex` | Male; female; other/indeterminate; unknown | Core | M05, M17, stratification |
| `age_current_years` | Age at specified reporting date | Derived | M05, M17 |
| `age_18_44_flag` | Age 18--44 years at reporting date | Derived | M05 |
| `age_17_44_flag` | Age 17--44 years at reporting date | Derived | M17 |

## Table 2. Contact and residence — restricted single record per person

| Variable | Meaning / values | Status | Metrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `internal_redcap_id` | Registry record key | Core | Linkage |
| `first_name`, `family_name`, `middle_name`, `previous_name` | Identifying or matching names | Core; Core; Extended; Extended | Recall/linkage |
| `phone_1`, `phone_2`, `phone_3`, `email` | Contact details | Core; Extended; Extended; Extended | Recall |
| `preferred_contact_method` | Phone; SMS; email; letter; family contact; community visit; other | Core | Recall |

Address history, if required after launch, is held in a separate repeating contact/residence update log rather than through duplicated address fields.

## Table 5. Laboratory results — repeating accepted result bundle

Each row is an accepted set of results linked to a diabetes-team blood-taking episode. `aset_request_id` is a specimen/request linkage value, not a patient identifier. Only rows marked accepted are available to routine reporting.

| Variable | Meaning / values | Status | Metrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lab_measurement_date` | Specimen collection date; use result date only if collection date is unavailable | Core | M07--M12, M16, M26 |
| `aset_request_id` | ASET accession/request identifier | Core | Safety/QC |
| `result_acceptance_status` | Accepted; pending query; rejected/wrong patient; not reviewed | Core | All laboratory metrics |
| `hba1c_mmol_mol` | IFCC HbA1c result | Core | M07--M12 |
| `hba1c_method_status` | Standardised; non-standardised; unknown | Core | M09 |
| `serum_creatinine_umol_l`, `egfr_ml_min_1_73m2` | Renal function results | Core | M16 |
| `urine_acr_mg_mmol` | Urine albumin:creatinine ratio | Core | M16 |
| `microalbuminuria_flag`, `clinical_proteinuria_flag` | Derived renal disease indicators, using thresholds specified in the SAP | Derived | M16 |
| `total_cholesterol_mmol_l` | Total cholesterol | Core | Clinical review |
| `urine_albumin_mg_l`, `urine_creatinine_mmol_l`, `hdl_cholesterol_mmol_l`, `ldl_cholesterol_mmol_l`, `triglycerides_mmol_l` | Supporting renal/lipid values | Extended | Clinical review |
| `haemoglobin_g_l`, `tsh_miu_l`, `alt_u_l`, `ast_u_l`, `alp_u_l`, `bilirubin_umol_l`, `albumin_g_l`, `total_protein_g_l` | Other laboratory results | Extended | Clinical review |

## Table 6. Lifestyle and preventive care — repeating

Use one event row for each relevant review or intervention. `intervention_status` has one shared value set: offered; referred; attended/received; completed; declined; not eligible; unknown.

| Variable | Meaning / values | Status | Metrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intervention_date` | Date of intervention, review or advice | Core | M13--M15, M17, M21, M26 |
| `intervention_type` | Structured education; dietary review; diet advice; physical-activity advice; smoking advice; GLP-1 programme; total meal replacement; DPP diet/exercise | Core | M13, M14, M17 |
| `intervention_status` | Shared status value set | Core | M13, M14, M17 |
| `provider_role` | Doctor; diabetes nurse; dietitian; community worker; pharmacist; other competent professional; unknown | Core | M14 |
| `structured_education_programme` | Named programme or local structured education pathway | Core when relevant | M13 |
| `influenza_immunisation_date` | Date influenza vaccination received | Core | M15 |
| `pregnancy_advice_date`, `pregnancy_advice_type`, `pregnancy_contraceptive_intention_recorded` | Pregnancy, pre-conception or contraception advice | Core when relevant | M17 |
| `smoking_status` | Current smoker; ex-smoker; never smoked; on NRT; unknown | Core | Clinical review |
| `intervention_notes` | Brief clinically necessary note | Extended | Clinical review |

## Build rules

- REDCap user rights must restrict Table 2 to staff who require identifiers for recall and record resolution.
- Record data-quality queries rather than overwriting uncertain results or classifications without an audit trail.
- Do not store a static current age; derive age against the reporting date.
- Do not add clinical reference-range flags until ranges, units, and clinical responsibility have been agreed locally.
- The Statistical Analysis Plan, rather than calculated fields alone, is the authoritative source for metric derivations.
